sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Mahjong Farm is its core gameplay mechanic: matching and clearing tiles from the deck. This simple yet engaging gameplay mechanic is the foundation upon which the game is built, and it's what makes Mahjong Farm so addictive. To play the game, you'll need to match two tiles that are on top of a stack, with the goal of clearing the deck before time runs out.

One of the key things to remember when playing Mahjong Farm is that you can only match tiles that are on top of a stack. This means that you'll need to think strategically about which tiles to match and when, in order to clear the deck as quickly as possible. As you progress through the game, the tiles will become increasingly difficult to match, requiring you to use your wits and think on your feet to clear the deck before time runs out.

In addition to the core gameplay mechanic, Mahjong Farm also features a variety of power-ups and special tiles that can be used to help you clear the deck. These power-ups can be used to clear entire stacks of tiles, freeze time, and even swap the positions of two tiles. While these power-ups can be helpful, they can also be used strategically to gain an advantage over your opponents.

Overall, Mahjong Farm's core gameplay mechanics are engaging, addictive, and easy to learn, making it a game that is perfect for players of all ages and skill levels.
